releaseNotes:
• Fix: SaveGaze VPN now works on Android 14–17 / Samsung One UI (e.g., Galaxy A16 5G) — sets blocking TUN mode + /24 subnet (`10.10.10.2/24`) preventing kernel EINVAL rejections, and adds IPv6 DNS upstreams.
• Fix: Multi-image grids & multi-person photos now blur all target-gender semi-nude subjects cleanly in Female-Only mode — 2x2 overlapping NudeNet tiles, sharper PordaV4x3 strips, cross-column cluster isolation, and orphan thumbnail grouping.
• Fix: Blocked keyword search now works inside Facebook and other social/content apps — scans search/editable inputs on 1-word hit, reacts to live typing, and inspects deep UI trees.
